title: Premium short shows for phones
text: A mobile-only streaming service with premium, Hollywood-made shows cut into episodes under ten minutes, for people watching on their phones in spare moments, at $4.99 a month with ads.
outcome: Quibi launched in April 2020 and shut down in December 2020 after raising about $1.75 billion.
